Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 2,023.08 on this filing (it is the filer's first report of the cycle, so period and YTD coincide) and is NOT summed as an increment. The p2 balance ladder closes on its own terms too: line 3 5,996.56 + line 4 2,023.08 = line 5 8,019.64; 8,019.64 - line 6 755.75 = line 7 7,263.89.

Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A figures. PAGE-FACE candidate name is 'Larry Alton Ellertson' (Republican, residence city Lindon) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it; the page-face Office Seeking line reads 'Utah County Commission Seat (c)', which agrees with index.csv's 'County Commission Seat C' and with the county's own filename, and is the same reading the 2026-08-01 vision pass used to retire the old 'seat unresolved' note. Schedule A row 1 is dated 2006 by the filer and Schedule A row 2 is bank interest rather than a contribution — both transcribed as printed, neither adjudicated. Every entry on both schedules is handwritten; this filing is NOT one of the county's *_Redacted.pdf files, so the address blocks were published in the clear by the county and were reduced to city/state at READ TIME by this transcription.
